title: Anthropic explains the invisible watermark planned for future Claude text
friendlyTitle: Future Claude text will carry an invisible signal
summary: Anthropic says future Claude models will use a SynthID-Text-based statistical watermark to support EU AI Act requirements. The pattern changes low-stakes word-selection randomness rather than adding hidden characters, carries no user identity, and is easier to detect in longer passages than short or heavily factual text.
friendlySummary: Anthropic plans to add a hidden statistical pattern to future Claude writing. It will not add secret characters or identify the user.
whyItMatters: People should not treat watermark detection as proof of authorship or misconduct: Anthropic says it only estimates whether Claude contributed to a passage, with important limits for short, edited, or factual material.
friendlyWhyItMatters: The signal may help show that Claude was involved, but it cannot prove who wrote the text or why.
